test_navigate_to_search.title: Verify clicking Search nav link loads the Global Search page.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Navigate to Search - LPR
steps.expected: Search - LPR page loads without errors

steps.action: Wait for the page to fully render
steps.expected: All page elements are loaded

steps.action: Locate Search button on the page
steps.expected: Search button is visible

steps.action: Inspect the current state of Search button
steps.expected: Search button enabled

steps.action: Set up precondition: after applying mandatory filters
steps.expected: Precondition is met (after applying mandatory filters)

steps.action: Verify no console errors or unexpected behavior
steps.expected: No errors in the browser console related to Search button

test_search_page_filters_visible.title: Verify all filter dropdowns are present on the Search page

steps.action: Click Search in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: The Category, Locations & Cameras and Duration filters are shown.
